candidates.statement: OPPQ Management will: • Review COSS proposals regarding which SDOs and SDO committees should have CDER Liaisons.
candidates.context: RESPONSIBILITIES COSS will: • Lead and coordinate the SLP in CDER, in accordance with this CDER MAPP. • Approve COSS Liaison proposals or suggest revisions. • Confirm appointment of CDER candidate Liaisons to SDOs.

candidates.statement: o Arrange for a substitute, as needed, if unable to attend a committee meeting. Alternatively, Liaisons can request fellow Liaisons, if any, on the committee to cover for them, or request a COSS employee to attend, if needed. Liaisons should help prepare the substitute for the meeting (e.g., with background materials, personal briefing).
candidates.context: o Attend meetings of the SDO committees to which they are assigned and participate in committee activities. • SDO committee activities – Liaisons will: o Participate in developing new standards and revising existing standards.

candidates.statement: o If serving as Liaison to an SDO technical panel that is advisory to a principal determinative SDO parent committee, provide timely alerts to the agency Liaison serving the principal SDO committee regarding any developing issues that may need to be addressed.
candidates.context: o Notify COSS if additional Liaison representation or technical expertise is needed to support standards development activities. o Take relevant standards-specific training courses coordinated by OPPQ.

candidates.statement: PROCEDURES • Selecting Liaisons o COSS creates a selection plan in which it recommends to OPPQ management which SDOs, and which of the SDOs’ committees, should have CDER Liaisons. COSS also includes in the plan how many CDER Liaisons should participate on each SDO committee and identifies the offices that should be contacted to request Liaison candidates.
